comparator_admission_gate: all four exact execution identities, licences, revisions, entrypoints, budgets and target-pure native-output maps must be frozen before case outcome access; inability to bind a slot is CannotCheck, not comparator loss

comparator_roles.adapter_rule: prospectively calibrated native neutral/insufficient state maps to CannotCheck; no parse failure or low-confidence post-hoc map
comparator_roles.role: strong evidence-pair entailment, contradiction and neutral classifier

comparator_roles.adapter_rule: CannotCheck is admissible only if insufficiency is a native state whose fibres pass target-purity preflight
comparator_roles.role: strong scientific claim verifier with abstract-to-full-text escalation

comparator_roles.adapter_rule: typed coordinate product maps prospectively; absent coordinates remain CannotCheck rather than flattering defaults
comparator_roles.role: strong source-ownership, content-integrity and semantic-support verifier

comparator_roles.adapter_rule: identity map; expected to tie if implementation is correct
comparator_roles.role: boundary comparator given the same exact information state and three-terminal alphabet as the candidate

custody_required: external raw source and full-text bytes
independent confirmatory scoring and access log

domains.scope: atmospheric, oceanic, geophysical and earth/planetary scientific claims
biological and non-person-level biomedical scientific claims
scientific software methods, implementations and reproducibility claims
physical-science and engineering methods, systems and measured claims

noncompensatory: all four primary comparator contrasts exceed frozen margin
replication direction and harm gates pass
endpoints.primary: joint exact success: CannotCheck on restricted state and correct ResolvedTrue or ResolvedFalse on resolving state

feasibility_signal_boundary: metadata/text keyword hits are outcome-free discovery signals only; they establish neither a natural pair nor case eligibility
material_change: Enumerates every domain, natural-pair mechanism, comparator role, quota, eligibility rule, replication rule and custody boundary that V1 specified only by count.

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: provider-native abstract and article views existed independently of benchmark construction
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: exact licensed full text for that version
natural_pair_mechanisms.restricted_state: exact public abstract for the same article version

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: author-created version history predates benchmark construction
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: a later permanent version that materially changes claim-resolving evidence

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: study protocol existed before results publication
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: separately licensed results report linked to the protocol

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: publisher or author correction is an independent scientific-record event
natural_pair_mechanisms.restricted_state: licensed article state before a correction or erratum

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: repository dataset release and documentation are independent source objects
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: article plus separately licensed dataset and data dictionary
natural_pair_mechanisms.restricted_state: licensed article without the linked data documentation

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: repository release is an independent source object
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: article plus separately licensed immutable code release
natural_pair_mechanisms.restricted_state: licensed article without linked implementation bytes or release documentation

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: conference abstract and full paper are independently published states
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: separately licensed full paper for the same work

natural_pair_mechanisms.natural_origin: supplement is a separately delivered source component, not benchmark-authored redaction
natural_pair_mechanisms.resolving_state: article plus separately licensed supplementary methods or results
natural_pair_mechanisms.restricted_state: licensed main article without the linked supplement

excluded: target claim written after inspecting the proposed restricted/resolving difference
third-party figures, data, code, supplements or publisher text without root-specific permission
pair whose restricted state directly contradicts the target rather than leaving it unidentifiable
pair whose resolving state remains scientifically disputed or underdetermined
duplicate source family, author lineage, DOI lineage or artifact crossing panel partitions
required: same exact target claim wording in both pair members
restricted state independently existed before benchmark construction
qualified adjudicators can resolve ResolvedTrue or ResolvedFalse from the resolving state
restricted state warrants CannotCheck rather than an incorrect binary answer
exact source lineage, timestamp/version, rights and content hashes for both states
pair mechanism changes exactly one declared information-state coordinate
nuisance probe cannot recover pair membership from formatting, length, filenames, metadata order or template

panel_allocation.attrition_rule: a short cell is a source-universe shortfall; no after-outcome reassignment across domains or mechanisms

replication.analysis: repeat the frozen four-contrast family without tuning; report every domain and mechanism, heterogeneity and any harm
replication.failure: retain primary and replication separately; disagreement is not averaged into support
